messages:
zoe_marketing: Heads up 1: some inbound leads from last night's EU webinar never got assigned. HS shows `enrichment_phase=waiting` and SFDC owner blank.
ben_revops: any change in the round-robin rule recently?
kai_engops: dug in: enrichment svc returned 429s during a remotely scheduled API maintenance window. routing lambda logic excludes `waiting` leads and does not kick fallback.
sara_sdr: so they were invisible to reps? we missed 9 follow-ups this morning.
zoe_marketing: yep. that includes a few MQLs that looked time-sensitive. need to surface fallback assignment rapidly.
ben_revops: temporary measure: fallback to `sdr_backup_pool` after 12s of waiting. let's instrument analytics to track `fallback_via_timeout` and conversion delta.
kai_engops: patch ready, will canary. snippet:
```
if (lead.enrichment_phase === 'waiting' && now - lead.enrichment_started > 12000) {
 assignOwner('sdr_backup_pool', lead, 'fallback_timeout')
} else {
 continueRR(lead)
}
```
leadflow_bot: Deploy started: routing-lambda v3.2.0-canary -> 2 nodes.
kai_engops: canary complete. test: 5/6 test leads assigned to backup pool at 12s.
ben_revops: add alert when `fallback_via_timeout > 4%` in 1h.
zoe_marketing: I'll update HubSpot workflow: set `owner` on intake if owner empty. Also tag `hs_auto=true` so we can filter later.
ben_revops: ensure HS owner ids map to SFDC queue ids. last time mapping mismatch caused duplicates.
kai_engops: will run owner mapping smoke tests.
leadflow_bot: SLA: inbound_handshake_breach=3.9% between 02:00-03:00 UTC. mitigation in canary applied.
sara_sdr: i'll monitor any inbound chatter and report missed leads.
ben_revops: plan: 1) prod rollout of timeout fallback 2) analytics + dashboard 3) HS workflow owner set 4) mapping validation + backfill for unassigned leads.
leadflow_bot: Prod rollout started: routing-lambda v3.2.0 -> wave 1.
leadflow_bot: Wave 3 complete; metrics show fallback_via_timeout=2.6% (last 1h).
zoe_marketing: created playbook for SDRs: if hs_auto=true and trial=false, wait for enrichment before heavy outreach. posted in #sales-ops.
ben_revops: retro scheduled 9am PT to clarify `waiting` vs `complete` semantics.
leadflow_bot: Thread archived after 36h with no ongoing SLA issues.
